claim: You can attach at most 10 SCPs directly to the root, to each OU and to each account, and every entity must keep at least 1 SCP attached while SCPs are enabled. Before May 15, 2026 the maximum was 5 SCPs per entity.
question: How many service control policies can be attached directly to a root, an OU or an account?

qualifiers.scope: per root, per OU, per account (directly attached; inherited policies do not count)
qualifiers.condition: all policy limits on this table are hard limits

evidence.quote: | Service control policy | 1 — Every entity must have at least one SCP attached at all times when you enable SCPs. You can't remove the last SCP from an entity. | 10 | 10 | 10 |
evidence.table_header: | Policy type | Minimum attached to an entity | Maximum attached to root | Maximum attached per OU | Maximum attached per account |

evidence.quote: The maximum number of SCPs that can be attached to a single node (root, OU, or account) has increased from 5 to 10, and the maximum SCP size has increased from 5,120 to 10,240 characters.

note: d024. GA 2026-05-15, before the 2026-07-15 cut-off, so examinable; older practice questions assume 5 SCPs per entity.

claim: A service control policy document can be at most 10,240 characters, while a resource control policy can be at most 5120 characters. Before May 15, 2026 the SCP maximum was 5,120 characters.
question: What is the maximum size of an SCP document and of an RCP document?

values.spoken: ten thousand two hundred forty characters
five thousand one hundred twenty characters

qualifiers.condition: the console removes extra white space before counting; the CLI and SDKs save the policy exactly as provided

evidence.quote:
| Maximum size of a policy document | Service control policies: 10,240 characters
Resource control policies: 5120 characters
Declarative policies: 10,000 characters
Backup policies: 10,000 characters
Chat applications policies: 10,000 characters
AI services opt-out policies: 2500 characters
Tag policies: 10,000 characters
Security Hub policies: 10,000 characters
**Note:** If you save the policy by using the AWS Management Console, extra white space (such as spaces and line breaks) between JSON elements and outside of quotation marks, is removed and not counted. If you save the policy using an SDK operation or the AWS CLI, then the policy is saved exactly as you provided and no automatic removal of characters occurs. |
The maximum number of SCPs that can be attached to a single node (root, OU, or account) has increased from 5 to 10, and the maximum SCP size has increased from 5,120 to 10,240 characters.
